verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events collects behavioral data from SDKs, the HTTP API and streaming sources, then stores it in the customer's warehouse. Identity Resolution writes unified identities and a one-row-per-identity Golden Record table there too, so both raw events and profiles land in data the customer owns. A community report adds that the hybrid architecture keeps all data in the customer's own warehouse or S3 bucket. Missing for 10: documentation that the customer controls the schedule or cadence of event and profile loads into the warehouse (the documented schedules apply to outbound syncs only), explicit first-party confirmation of Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse and S3 as supported landing targets, and hands-on corroboration.
